description: Standalone, proposals-only Living Context recall contract (Context Check 1.1, issue #1131). Extends knowledge.context-check without changing it: a required reader identity that fails closed, as-of on valid time and knowledge time (Surface knowledge-accumulation semantics), per-result reasons, an explicit whole-result token budget, and a separate answer step that abstains through Survey support verification. Contextual status here is not a Surface trust status; freshness is Surface's own claim-intrinsic expiry; Ops #121 holds/broken/unverifiable stays consumer vocabulary. Recall returns evidence, never an answer.

expects.description: The input binds workspace, repository, exact Git commit SHA, changed surfaces or diff, target audience, selected Knowledge roots, a reader identity, an as-of (explicit now; valid_at and known_at default to it) and an explicit token budget. A missing or blank reader, or one no selected root recognises, is refused at every root before any claim is parsed and before any file is written; visibility is Surface's declared form and anything unreadable is sealed, never widened. No wall clock is read.

Recall returns evidence only: each resolved result carries its contextual status as of the stated valid and knowledge instants, authority citation, retrieval provenance, matched signals, freshness, review posture, supersession chain and status reasons (a plain no-answer carries none, by design). Supersession is Surface's per-viewer view over the edges admitted at the as-of instants (recorded, same slot, in effect): a superseded claim is never current for a reader who can see such a successor along an edge they may see; a successor the reader cannot see leaves it current with no trace; an untimed visible successor, a cross-slot edge or a visible cycle makes it unverifiable. Absent, hidden and not-yet-known claims are indistinguishable by id. Results are kept or dropped whole under the budget; every drop is named and a drop is never a pass.

The answer step is separate from recall. It re-derives recall and sends only a current recall, with its authority read at the pinned revision, to an independent Survey SupportVerifier. Only a supported verdict answers; contradicted is reported; not-addressed, abstained, timed-out, unreadable, empty or oversized evidence, and budget drops abstain. Each verdict is kept as Survey's immutable CandidateVerification record. Any abstention makes the set not_verified.

Only claims the reader may see and that are not known to be later than the knowledge instant are reconciled (an untimed claim is reconciled as unverifiable); an intersection with the bounded change is neutral affected/requires-reconciliation, and contradicted requires explicit authoritative evidence. Reconciliation is not skipped for results the budget dropped.

The adapter emits only minimal proposed updates routed to each claim's owning source and writes only new no-follow files under an explicit private run/proposal directory. It never edits documentation, decisions, or Knowledge records.
